items.headline: Best-Positioned Stocks as EV and Self-Driving Tech Accelerate
items.snippet: Albemarle appears well-positioned to benefit as EV demand grows globally, thanks to a lithium resource base built to serve that demand and a pipeline of projects aimed at expanding it. Albemarle projects 10-20% CAGR for lithium demand from 2025 to 2030.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized the tight lithium market due to strong demand in EVs and stationary storage, with supply lagging demand. The company maintained its overall 2026 outlook, expecting to perform at the high end of scenario ranges.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock amid softer EV demand in China, elevated inventory and expected supply from mine restarts.

items.headline: The demand for lithium carbonate is expected to continue its growth trend, with potential for price increases.
items.snippet: In South American salt lakes, Albemarle's (ALB) capacity in Chile has been affected by strikes and is in labor negotiation. Historical experience suggests limited impact on actual supply.

items.headline: Atlas Lithium Materially De-Risks Neves Project with 71% of Direct Capital Budget Already Contracted
items.snippet: On its Q2 2026 earnings call held August 6, 2026, Albemarle reported that global lithium consumption grew 45% year-over-year through May 2026, while new supply additions lagged.

items.headline: Atlas Lithium Announce ~71% Of Neves Project Capex Is Supported By Executed Contracts
